name: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment - II

name: Flame Extinction Experiment
val_objectives: Measure flame extinction of isolated liquid fuel droplets under varied diluents (CO2, N2, He) and pressures to study radiative and diffusive extinction
val_sample_shape: spherical liquid droplet on SiC fibers
prov_cabin_o2_note: Tested cabin O2 range 12.0-34.0% reported across 271 test rows in authentic experimental table (sha256: 37c88ce8ae9391b7544ff630a45ce87543d04d317cdbfbed104fe7d5c27e1b96)
prov_pressure_note: Converted from 2319.9 mmHg via exact formula 1 mmHg = 14.6959488/760 psi; 0.0 mmHg values treated as null (unpressurized/not reported)
val_varied_variables: initial droplet diameter; diluent species (CO2, He, N2); chamber pressure; oxygen dilution mole fraction
val_constant_variables: ambient temperature (298 K); quiescent flow environment
val_sensors: High-speed color camera; UV radiometer; Infrared radiometer; Backlit droplet camera

name: Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
val_objectives: Study the flammability boundaries, low-temperature combustion kinetics, and extinction of non-premixed cool diffusion flames in microgravity under oxygen-enriched coflow
val_fuels: 30% butane; 30% ethane; 30% propane; 50% butane; ethane; propane
val_varied_variables: fuel gas species; burner flow O2 concentration (21-85%); coflow velocity; diluent type (N2 vs He)
val_sensors: Photomultiplier Tube (PMT); Color video cameras; Chamber gas chromatograph; Broadband radiometer

name: Flame Extinction Experiment - 2
val_objectives: Study droplet extinction dynamics, burning rates, and limiting oxygen indices for binary fuel droplets and droplet arrays in microgravity
val_fuels: Heptane/hexadecane mixtures; Methanol/water mixtures; Ethanol; Decane
val_sample_shape: droplet pairs and small droplet arrays
prov_cabin_o2_note: Stated envelope 10-40% O2 mole fraction in metadata (0.1 mole fraction = 10% O2, 0.4 mole fraction = 40% O2 exact). Table-listed flight test runs report discrete oxygen concentrations {17, 21, 25, 30}% across 8 rows in PSI-68_Experimental table_Flex2.csv
prov_pressure_note: Converted from 0.5 - 3.0 atm using exact formula 1 atm = 14.6959 psi
prov_airflow_note: Tested convective flow velocities 0.1-5.0 cm/s reported across 8 test rows in authentic experimental table
val_varied_variables: binary mixture composition; droplet spacing ratio; diluent gas concentration
val_sensors: High-speed video camera; OH* chemiluminescence radiometer; Infrared radiometer
